title: SaaS & Technology
standingRules: Distinguish trial, paying and churned accounts in every summary — context changes everything.
Bug reports and outage mentions route to support tooling, never to sales cadences.
Usage data beats opinions: cite product events when describing account health.
compliance: Security questionnaire answers come from the approved library only — never improvised.

corridorHints.speed-to-lead: Route by segment: self-serve signups get product-led follow-up, enterprise inquiries get a human call offer.
corridorHints.reporting-autopilot: Lead with MRR movement and activation rate; vanity metrics go last or nowhere.
